rows.en:
(Gary-sensei was supposed to look over
my self-training today...)

Hey, \p.
Sorry to keep you waiting!

No, not really...
Thanks for coaching my training today!
Mm, good answer. But what's with that getup?
Uh, it's just a regular EX-Gear...

You idiot!
Wearing EX-Gear to MY training? You're a hundred
years too early! Go take it off right now!
Huh?! Y-yes!
Your answer's too sluggish!
All right, get going!
Sensei, I took it off!
Too slow!
Sorry!

Dawdle like that and you won't survive
on the battlefield.
Yes, I'm sorry!
Do it over! Put the EX-Gear back on and come back!
Yes, I'm on my way!
Ah, wait a sec!
Yes?
rows.notes: x8: player, Luca, Shirakawa, Nanase in various scenes.

rows.en:
On top of that, go to the school store
and buy me a hippo-cow milk coffee!
Huh? Y-yes...
Answer properly!
Sensei, I'm back!

Mm, that was faster than before.
Now go take it off again!
Oh, and leave the milk coffee here.
Yes, understood!
rows.notes: x8, player in Gary, Hilda and Sheryl scenes.

rows.en:
Huff, huff...
Sensei, I took it off!
Mm, not bad. Let's leave it at that for today.
Point is, give everything your all. Dismissed!
Um, er... Thank you very much!

Mm.
Oh, and by the way, I helped myself
to the milk coffee.
Oh, okay...
rows.notes: x18 across many scenes; also Akimizu once.

rows.en: Take this lesson to heart. See ya.
(Was that even training? Hmm...)

(Gary-sensei was supposed to look over
my self-training today...)
Yes, it's just a regular EX-Gear, though...
Yes, I'm sorry.
Yes!
(Was that even training? Hmm...)

(Today for sure, Gary-sensei is gonna coach
my self-training...)

No, not that long...
Thanks for coaching my training today!
...Hm... Ah... Was that today...?
Huh, Sensei?

Ah... Clean forgot!
Today's, uh, the thing... the staff meeting... yeah...
What?! Really?

Yeah, sorry 'bout that.
Just do whatever. See ya.
(Gary-sensei... is there really a staff meeting...?)

(Today for sure, Gary-sensei's gonna coach
my self-training!)

(Gary-sensei... I wonder if there's really
a staff meeting...)
(We were supposed to meet on the roof today...)

No, I just got here myself.
Thanks for coaching my training again today!
Mm. Now, as for today's training... let's see...

We're gonna swim, to build full-body strength
and cardiopulmonary endurance!
Huh? What about EX-Gear training...

You idiot! Basic fitness comes before anything!
Build up your basic fitness and your piloting
will improve by leaps and bounds!
Ah, yes, sorry about that!

All right, get changed and meet me at the pool,
on the double!
Gary-sensei...
Hm? What is it?
Looks like the girls' swim team is using it...

Yeah, looks like it, but it can't be helped.
We'll train right alongside 'em.
Huh? That's kind of a bad idea...
Sensei, so, what should we do?
Well now... just as I figured... huh...
rows.notes: Gary mumbling while eyeing the swim team.

rows.en: Ooh, that one's looking pretty good...
Sensei?

Whoa! Now that's dangerous.
That's practically against the rules...
Sensei!
Hm?! Ah, right, first off...
What are you doing?
Ah, Hilda-sensei!

Ah, well, right now, uh, y'know,
I'm training this kid here...
I see. How hard for you.

Well, yeah.
Looking after students is just part of being a teacher.

Indeed. But we are using this place right now.
Go somewhere else.
No, but listen...
Go somewhere else.
Sir, yes, sir!
Tch, that woman's got no charm at all...
Sensei, we got kicked out, huh...

Well, on the battlefield you gotta adapt
to the unexpected, too.

All right, let's wrap it up here for today.
Dismissed!

uncertain: c05102 (x8): Gary's bare 'Henji!' rendered 'Answer properly!' (he wants a crisp 'Yes!'; the player then answers 'Yes!').
